summary.text: Arnie Davis is a Republican state representative from Coos District 2 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Arnold Davis, says he worked as a home inspector and owned a tree and landscape service.

paragraphs.text: Arnold Davis lives in Milan, New Hampshire, and graduated from Berlin High School.
His career experience includes working as a home inspector and owning and operating a tree and landscape service.
Davis assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 2, 2020, succeeding Democrat Wayne Moynihan.
Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Environment and Agriculture Committee for 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Coos 2, where Lincoln Robertson is also a candidate.
